task_description:
# Enhanced Multi-Profile Support

Improve user profiles with individual watch histories, preferences, and recommendations. Support profile switching on TV without re-authentication.

## Rationale
User profiles exist but can be enhanced to support family use. This addresses the household sharing use case and prepares for parental controls. Competitors like Plex and Netflix have robust profile systems.

## User Stories
- As a family member, I want my own profile so that my watch history doesn't mix with others
- As a parent, I want a PIN on my profile so that kids can't access my viewing history
- As a TV user, I want to quickly switch profiles so that family members can easily change who's watching

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each profile has separate watch history and continue watching
- [ ] Profile-specific recommendations based on individual viewing
- [ ] Quick profile switcher accessible from all screens
- [ ] Profile avatars and customization options
- [ ] PIN protection option for individual profiles
- [ ] TV interface supports easy profile switching with remote
